title: 📢IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT FOR STUDENTS 🎓 Mid-Term Examinations Fall 2026
text:
Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan

Director Academics & Research

📢 IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT FOR STUDENTS

🎓 Mid-Term Examinations
Fall 2026

Commencing
Monday, 26 October 2026

Venues
Three centralized venues

Dear Students,

Please be informed that
Mid-Term Examinations for all students, except those enrolled in the 1st Semester, will commence on Monday, 26 October 2026.
Examinations will be conducted at
three centralized examination venues
.

All concerned students are advised to take the following actions immediately to avoid any inconvenience:

1
🔔 Registration Status

✅ Ensure that your registration is complete and verified.

⏰ FINAL DEADLINE
Friday, 16 October 2026 (SHARP)

⚠️ Students with pending registration must complete the process within the stipulated deadline.

2
🪪 E-Registration / Examination Card — Mandatory

🚨 NO CARD, NO ENTRY! 🚨

All students must:

Log in to their respective
MIS accounts
.

Download their valid
E-Registration/Examination Card
well in advance.

Ensure that all outstanding dues have been cleared to make the card available for download.

❌ Students without a valid Examination Card will NOT be permitted to enter the examination venue.

⚠️ Important Reminders

Complete your registration before the deadline.

Clear all outstanding dues.

Download and save your Examination Card in advance.

Follow all official examination instructions issued by the university.

📌 DO NOT WAIT UNTIL THE LAST DAY!
Take the necessary steps now to ensure a smooth and hassle-free examination process.

Your cooperation and timely compliance are highly appreciated.

Director Academics & Research

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan

🎓 Stay Prepared. Stay Compliant. Excel in Your Examinations!
